'''Masayuki Omoro''' (Japanese: '''小室正幸''' ''Omoro Masayuki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. He was born on March 6, 1948 in {{wp|Ishikawa Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. 

==Pokémon roles==
Omoro began his work on {{aniseries|PTS}} near the end of {{aniseries|RS}}, providing the voice of {{an|Brandon}}. While in {{aniseries|BW}}, his only role was [[Team Rocket scientist]]s, [[Dr. Zager]].
